moves.what_it_does: Relaunch a worker with a reviewed serving profile (model, parser, chat template, flags and limits). Repairs a worker whose configuration differs from the reviewed one. Takes the worker out of rotation while it restarts.

payload.expected_effect: target-b will be relaunched with the reviewed serving profile, fixing max_num_seqs to the default (vllm default) and bringing p95 latency back within the 0.5 s limit. The worker will be temporarily out of rotation during restart.
payload.reasoning: target-b is misconfigured with max_num_seqs=1, causing p95 latency of ~4.5 s (exceeding the 0.5 s limit). The config-diff probe (ev-002) confirms it differs from the reviewed config on max_num_seqs. The apply-serving-profile move will relaunch target-b with a reviewed serving profile that should restore proper max_num_seqs and latency. target-a is healthy and requires no action. This move restores service for users by fixing the root cause.
payload.risk: Low risk — the move targets the exact misconfiguration (max_num_seqs) identified. The worker is taken out of rotation during restart, so no in-flight requests are disrupted. The profile being applied is the reviewed/approved one, so it aligns with the expected configuration.
